notes: QSC KW Series User Manual (TD-000315-01-G), specifications table, KW153 column. Drivers: 15 in LF cone, 6.5 in mid-range cone, 1.75 in compression driver = 3 drivers; nominal coverage 75 deg axisymmetric (-6 dB); max SPL 134 dB peak at 1 m; 43.1 x 18.5 x 16.8 in. The same manual gives net weight as 87 lb (39.5 kg) in the table but 88 lb (39.9 kg) in the text, so weight is left N/A. No sensitivity or passive impedance published (active).
